entities.name: Obsidian Well
entities.description: City of dragons carved inside a mountain on Dominaria during the reign of the Primevals.

entities.name: Primevals
entities.description: Rulers whose reign saw the dragons' city; they fell c. -17,000 AR.

entities.name: Rokin
entities.description: Slave from Mitrokin village held in the Obsidian Well.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where the Obsidian Well stood.

events.summary: The dragons of the Obsidian Well keep and torment many slaves, among them Rokin.
When the Primevals fall, the slaves revolt and kill the dragon leaders.
events.quote: the slaves revolted and killed the dragon leaders

relations.quote: One of these slaves was Rokin from Mitrokin village.
